cells.caveat: UPPER BOUND -- sampled from the slowest (longest-horizon) steps; the horizon recedes as the episode advances.

decision_rule: per-policy: <4h full grid; 4-12h full grid overnight; 12-40h reduce to 3 G4 sites; >40h retain analytic (s,S) and disclose

decision_per_policy.MPC (H=24): re-run FULL grid, schedule overnight (6.57 h)
decision_per_policy.Oracle-MPC (H=360): reduce to the 3 G4 sites, ~7.6 h, disclose scope

note: Single-cell extrapolation. Solve time varies with state; treat as an order-of-magnitude estimate.
